options.name: Calm Technical Precision
options.content_fit: Matches a technical education reel without looking like a software template.
options.risk: Could feel clinical if the presenter close-ups are removed.

typography.weight_strategy: Use 700 for the one decisive phrase and 500 elsewhere.

motion.style: Short purposeful reveals with no idle floating.

captions.emphasis: One active phrase at a time in the accent color.

color_grade.look_description: Neutral skin tone with slightly reduced saturation.

audio.sound_effects: Sparse motivated ticks and one soft impact.
audio.silence: Use only for authored pre-roll and final hold.

options.name: Warm Editorial
options.content_fit: Adds personality while remaining clean and credible.
options.risk: The editorial metaphor may compete with the software-timing subject.

selection.reason: It makes the timing diagram feel premium without adding a branded-template look.

oversaturated_color.evidence: Preview scopes and visual review show one restrained accent.

cheesy_transitions_or_fx.evidence: Every transition communicates a clock-state change.

cluttered_frames.evidence: No frame contains more than one diagram plus captions.

generic_or_templated.evidence: The visual system is derived from the one-clock concept.

reject_reflex_review.notes: Keep presenter close-ups to prevent the technical treatment from becoming sterile.
